viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder or create a traceability project in your workspace.
[Open Project Folder](command:reqtrace.openProject)
[Create Project](command:reqtrace.createProject)
[Get Started](command:reqtrace.getStarted)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Requirements Traceability
walkthroughs.description: Set up a project and review its coverage.

steps.title: Open a project folder
steps.description:
Choose a folder or enter its path. Create a configuration if the folder does not already have one.
[Open project folder](command:reqtrace.openProject)

steps.title: Add sources and a coverage rule
steps.description:
Choose the documents or connectors to analyze, then define which source covers another.
[Add source](command:reqtrace.addSource)
[Add coverage rule](command:reqtrace.addRule)

steps.title: Review traceability
steps.description:
Explore links, coverage, and issues in the dashboard.
[Open dashboard](command:reqtrace.dashboard)

steps.title: Share a report
steps.description:
Generate an HTML report after reviewing the analysis issues.
[Generate report](command:reqtrace.report)
